tests.name: Seeded city is reproducible, collision-safe and contains 400+ buildings
All nine vehicle types accelerate with finite, bounded physics
Player can enter, drive and exit a nearby vehicle
NPC damage does not implicate the player
Fourteen story missions progress through every objective to completion
Timed failure retains a retry path
Property ownership, hourly income, garage and saves persist
Taxi shift requires a cab and pays five fares
Repair, medical care, resupply and concealed respray work
Police helicopter activates, tracks and deploys real officers
WASTED and BUSTED restore health and clear pursuit
GPS A-star returns contiguous road intersections
Helicopter search can be escaped rather than seeing through buildings
Stunt ramps launch a fast vehicle and reward a clean landing
Long simulation and each staged scenario remain finite
